user.title: Create a shopping route
user.description: Shopping item names and section descriptions are sent to the selected AI Task provider. Classifications are cached in Home Assistant storage for this profile.

data.display_section_prefix: Prefix item names with their section

data_description.sections: One section per line: SECTION NAME | optional hints. Line order is the walking route.
data_description.display_section_prefix: Only changes how the calculated list is displayed. The source list is never renamed.
data_description.price_chain: Optional. Adds a price and specials indicator from a New Zealand supermarket. This sends each item name to that retailer's public product search. Choose none to send item names only to the AI Task.
data_description.price_store_id: Pak'nSave only: store name or ID, because prices differ per store. Leave blank for Woolworths, whose public search is not store-scoped.
data_description.grocer_store_id: Optional. The numeric grocer.nz store ID for multi-year price history, which is the only way to see Pak'nSave specials. Find it in the store's URL on grocer.nz. Left blank, the integration keeps its own history from the first reading instead.

reconfigure.title: Edit shopping route
reconfigure.description: Changing route order does not reclassify items. Use Reclassify all after material hint changes.
